q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We’ll email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month, offering unlimited notes and 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month, so for 5 people, it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes. Let me know if you need help upgrading!

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, you can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to process it.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought Plus three weeks ago, a refund is no longer possible. Let me know if you need help with anything else!

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app, but Linux users can use the web app in any modern browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. Android 11 users can use the web app in a browser.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires an internet connection. Offline use is only available with the mobile or desktop apps.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export and choose to export all notes as PDF. The exported ZIP file will be emailed to you.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes are kept in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, find your note, and click "Restore" to recover it.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer:
No, SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps.  
Go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication to set it up.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer:
No, you keep Plus features until the end of your current billing period.  
To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.  
Let us know if you need help!

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply to support emails within one business day. If you need help, please email support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer:
We do not currently offer student discounts.  
You may consider our Free plan or explore Plus/Team pricing, which includes a 20% savings with annual billing.  
For further help, email support@example.com.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know if Example Notes is HIPAA compliant. If you need further assistance, I can open a support ticket for you.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer:
We don't support importing from Evernote. You can export your notes as Markdown or PDF from Evernote and manually add them to Example Notes.  
For further help, contact support@example.com.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: We currently do not have a Linux desktop app, and there is no announced release date. Linux users can use the web app instead. If you’d like updates, feel free to contact support@example.com.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I can't help with Python scripts. For support with Example Notes, please refer to the FAQ or email support@example.com.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't know the current weather in Tokyo. I can only help with questions about Example Notes. Let me know if you need assistance with the app!

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days—open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan ($8 per user per month) includes shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Yes, since you purchased within the last 14 days, you’re eligible for a full refund. Contact support with your order number to request it.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れました」をクリックしてください。30分以内に有効なリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry your notes were lost—deleted notes are kept in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore." If you don’t see them there, please email support@example.com with details—we’ll help immediately.
